# Runtime. Three dependencies, all load-bearing.
#
# openai>=2 — the v1 Responses API surface, and `api_key` accepting a
#   callable, which is what makes per-request Entra tokens work.
# azure-identity>=1.19 — DefaultAzureCredential and get_bearer_token_provider,
#   including the azure.identity.aio variants the async client requires.
# aiohttp>=3.9 — async transport used by azure.identity.aio. Importing the
#   async credential without it fails before the first request.
openai>=2
azure-identity>=1.19
aiohttp>=3.9

# Structured output only. The OpenAI SDK builds the JSON schema from a
# pydantic model class passed to responses.parse(text_format=...).
pydantic>=2
mcp>=1.27.1,<2
httpx>=0.27

# Tests. No cloud, no network: every test injects a fake client.
pytest>=8
pytest-asyncio>=0.23
